option_relations.rationale: Eosinophilic annular erythema is a specific dermatological condition, but it is not directly related to the broader concept of an immune-related adverse event of immunotherapy.
Wells syndrome is a specific dermatological condition, but it is not directly related to the broader concept of an immune-related adverse event of immunotherapy.
Granuloma annulare is a specific dermatological condition, but it is not directly related to the broader concept of an immune-related adverse event of immunotherapy.
Drug-induced erythema annulare centrifugum, especially in the context of immunotherapy, can be considered a specific type of immune-related adverse event.
